segments.arabic: [1140] حدثنا عبد الله بن يوسف أخبرنا مالك عن مخرمة بن سليمان عن كريب مولى ابن عباس أنه أخبره عن عبد الله بن عباس رضى الله تعالى عنهما
segments.english: ‘Abdullah ibn Yusuf related to us. Malik informed us, from Makhramah ibn Sulayman, from Kurayb, the mawla of Ibn ‘Abbas, that he informed him, from ‘Abdullah ibn ‘Abbas, may Allah Most High be pleased with them both:

segments.arabic: أنه بات عند ميمونة أم المؤمنين رضى الله تعالى عنها وهي خالته قال: فاضطجعت على عرض الوسادة واضطجع رسول الله ﷺ وأهله في طولها فنام رسول الله ﷺ حتى انتصف الليل أو قبله بقليل أو بعده بقليل ثم استيقظ رسول الله ﷺ فجلس فمسح النوم عن وجهه بيده ثم قرأ العشر آيات خواتيم سورة آل عمران ثم قام إلى شن معلقة فتوضأ منها فأحسن وضوءه ثم قام يصلي
segments.english: He spent the night with Maymunah, Mother of the Believers, may Allah Most High be pleased with her, who was his maternal aunt. He said: I lay down across the pillow, and the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, and his wife lay along its length. The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, slept until midnight, or a little before it, or a little after it. Then the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, awoke, sat up and wiped the sleep from his face with his hand. Then he recited the ten verses at the end of Surat Al ‘Imran. Then he went to a hanging worn waterskin and performed ablution from it, performing his ablution well. Then he stood to pray.

segments.arabic: قال عبد الله بن عباس رضى الله تعالى عنهما فقمت فصنعت مثل ما صنع ثم ذهبت فقمت إلى جنبه فوضع رسول الله ﷺ يده اليمنى على رأسي وأخذ بأذني اليمنى يفتلها بيده فصلى ركعتين ثم ركعتين ثم ركعتين ثم ركعتين ثم ركعتين ثم ركعتين ثم أوتر ثم اضطجع حتى جاءه المؤذن فقام فصلى ركعتين خفيفتين ثم خرج فصلى الصبح
segments.english: ‘Abdullah ibn ‘Abbas, may Allah Most High be pleased with them both, said: I got up and did as he had done. Then I went and stood beside him. The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, placed his right hand on my head and took my right ear, twisting it with his hand. He prayed two rak‘ahs, then two rak‘ahs, then two rak‘ahs, then two rak‘ahs, then two rak‘ahs, then two rak‘ahs, then prayed Witr. Then he lay down until the caller to prayer came to him. He got up and prayed two light rak‘ahs, then went out and prayed the morning prayer.

checkedBody: Narrated Kuraib Maula Ibn Abbas:

'Abdullah bin Abbas said that he had passed a night in the house of Maimuna the mother of the faithful believers , who was his aunt. He said, "I slept across the bed, and Allah's Apostle along with his wife slept lengthwise. Allah's Apostle slept till mid-night or slightly before or after it. Then Allah's Apostle woke up, sat, and removed the traces of sleep by rubbing his hands over his face. Then he recited the last ten verses of Surat-Al Imran (2). Then he went towards a hanging leather water-container and performed a perfect ablution and then stood up for prayer." 'Abdullah bin Abbas added, "I got up and did the same as Allah's Apostle had done and then went and stood by his side. Allah's Apostle then put his right hand over my head and caught my right ear and twisted it. He offered two Rakat, then two Rakat, then two Rakat, then two Rakat, then two Rakat, then two Rakat and then offered one Raka Witr. Then he lay down till the Muadh-dhin came and then he prayed two light Rakat and went out and offered the early morning (Fajr) prayer."

segments.arabic: [1143] حدثنا عبد الله بن مسلمة حدثنا عبد العزيز بن أبي حازم عن أبيه عن سهل رضى الله تعالى عنه قال
segments.english: ‘Abdullah ibn Maslamah related to us. ‘Abd al-‘Aziz ibn Abi Hazim related to us, from his father, from Sahl, may Allah Most High be pleased with him, who said:

segments.arabic: خرج النبي ﷺ يصلح بين بني عمرو بن عوف وحانت الصلاة فجاء بلال أبا بكر رضى الله تعالى عنهما، فقال حبس النبي ﷺ فتؤم الناس قال: نعم إن شئتم فأقام بلال الصلاة فتقدم أبو بكر رضى الله تعالى عنه فصلى فجاء النبي ﷺ يمشي في الصفوف يشقها شقا حتى قام في الصف الأول فأخذ الناس بالتصفيح
segments.english: The Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, went out to reconcile Banu ‘Amr ibn ‘Awf, and the time for prayer came. Bilal came to Abu Bakr, may Allah Most High be pleased with them both, and said, “The Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, has been delayed. Will you lead the people?” He said, “Yes, if you wish.” Bilal called the iqamah for prayer. Abu Bakr, may Allah Most High be pleased with him, went forward and prayed. The Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, came walking through the rows, making his way through them, until he stood in the first row. The people began clapping.

segments.arabic: قال سهل هل تدرون ما التصفيح هو التصفيق
segments.english: Sahl said: Do you know what tasfih is? It is tasfiq—clapping.

segments.arabic: وكان أبو بكر رضى الله تعالى عنه لا يلتفت في صلاته فلما أكثروا التفت فإذا النبي ﷺ في الصف فأشار إليه مكانك فرفع أبو بكر يديه فحمد الله ثم رجع القهقري وراءه وتقدم النبي ﷺ فصلى
segments.english: Abu Bakr, may Allah Most High be pleased with him, did not turn around during his prayer. When they increased it, he turned, and there was the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, in the row. He signalled to him, “Stay where you are.” Abu Bakr raised his hands and praised Allah. Then he stepped backwards behind him, and the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, went forward and prayed.

checkedBody: Narrated Sahl bin Sad:

The Prophet went out to affect a reconciliation between the tribes of Bani 'Amr bin 'Auf and the time of the prayer became due; Bilal went to Abu Bakr and said, "The Prophet is detained. Will you lead the people in the prayer?" Abu Bakr replied, "Yes, if you wish." So Bilal pronounced the Iqama and Abu Bakr led the prayer. In the meantime the Prophet came crossing the rows (of the praying people) till he stood in the first row and the people started clapping. Abu Bakr never looked hither and thither during the prayer but when the people clapped too much, he looked back and saw the Prophet in the (first) row. The Prophet waved him to remain at his place, but Abu Bakr raised both his hands and sent praises to Allah and then retreated and the Prophet went forward and led the prayer. (See Hadith No. 295 & 296)

segments.english: ‘Amr ibn ‘Isa related to us. Abu ‘Abd al-Samad, ‘Abd al-‘Aziz ibn ‘Abd al-Samad, related to us. Husayn ibn ‘Abd al-Rahman related to us, from Abu Wa’il, from ‘Abdullah ibn Mas‘ud, may Allah Most High be pleased with him, who said:

segments.arabic: كنا نقول التحية في الصلاة ونسمي ويسلم بعضنا على بعض فسمعه رسول الله ﷺ، فقال
segments.english: We used to say the greeting in prayer and name people, and some of us would greet others. The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, heard it and said:

segments.arabic: قولوا التحيات لله والصلوات والطيبات السلام عليك أيها النبي ورحمة الله وبركاته السلام علينا وعلى عباد الله الصالحين أشهد أن لا إله إلا الله وأشهد أن محمدا عبده ورسوله فإنكم إذا فعلتم ذلك فقد سلمتم على كل عبد لله صالح في السماء والأرض
segments.english: Say: “Greetings belong to Allah, and prayers and good things. Peace be upon you, O Prophet, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings. Peace be upon us and upon Allah’s righteous servants. I bear witness that there is no god but Allah, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and His Messenger.” For when you do that, you have greeted every righteous servant of Allah in heaven and earth.

checkedBody: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Masud:

We used to say the greeting, name and greet each other in the prayer. Allah's Apostle heard it and said:--"Say, 'At-tahiyyatu lil-lahi was-salawatu wat-taiyibatu . Assalamu 'Alaika aiyuha-n-Nabiyu wa-rahmatu-l-lahi wa-barakatuhu. _ Assalamu alaina wa-'ala 'ibadi-l-lahi as-salihin.. Ashhadu an la ilaha illa-l-lah wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan 'abdu hu wa Rasuluh. (All the compliments are for Allah and all the prayers and all the good things (are for Allah). Peace be on you, O Prophet, and Allah's mercy and blessings (are on you). And peace be on us and on the good (pious) worshipers of Allah. I testify that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah and that Muhammad is His slave and Apostle.) So, when you have said this, then you have surely sent the greetings to every good (pious) worship per of Allah, whether he be in the Heaven or on the Earth . "

segments.arabic: أن المسلمين بينا هم في الفجر يوم الإثنين وأبو بكر رضى الله تعالى عنه يصلي بهم ففجأهم النبي ﷺ قد كشف ستر حجرة عائشة رضى الله تعالى عنها فنظر إليهم وهم صفوف فتبسم يضحك فنكص أبو بكر رضى الله تعالى عنه على عقبيه وظن أن رسول الله ﷺ يريد أن يخرج إلى الصلاة وهم المسلمون أن يفتتنوا في صلاتهم فرحا بالنبي ﷺ حين رأوه فأشار بيده أن أتموا ثم دخل الحجرة وأرخى الستر وتوفي ذلك اليوم
segments.english: While the Muslims were at the Fajr prayer on Monday and Abu Bakr, may Allah Most High be pleased with him, was leading them in prayer, the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, suddenly appeared to them, having drawn aside the curtain of ‘A’ishah’s room, may Allah Most High be pleased with her. He looked at them as they stood in rows and smiled, laughing. Abu Bakr, may Allah Most High be pleased with him, stepped backwards, thinking that the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, wanted to come out to the prayer. The Muslims were on the point of being distracted in their prayer out of joy at the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, when they saw him. He signalled with his hand that they should complete it. Then he entered the room and let down the curtain. He died that day.

segments.arabic: [1148] وقال الليث حدثني جعفر عن عبد الرحمن بن هرمز قال أبو هريرة رضى الله تعالى عنه قال رسول الله ﷺ:

segments.arabic: نادت امرأة ابنها وهو في صومعة قالت: يا جريج قال اللهم أمي وصلاتي قالت: يا جريج قال اللهم أمي وصلاتي قالت: يا جريج قال اللهم أمي وصلاتي قالت اللهم لا يموت جريج حتى ينظر في وجه المياميس
segments.english: A woman called to her son while he was in a hermitage. She said, “O Jurayj!” He said, “O Allah, my mother and my prayer!” She said, “O Jurayj!” He said, “O Allah, my mother and my prayer!” She said, “O Jurayj!” He said, “O Allah, my mother and my prayer!” She said, “O Allah, may Jurayj not die until he looks upon the faces of prostitutes.”

segments.arabic: وكانت تأوي إلى صومعته راعية ترعى الغنم فولدت فقيل لها ممن هذا الولد قالت من جريج نزل من صومعته قال جريج أين هذه التي تزعم أن ولدها لي قال: يا بابوس من أبوك قال راعي الغنم
segments.english: A shepherdess who tended sheep used to come to his hermitage. She gave birth, and she was asked, “By whom is this child?” She said, “By Jurayj.” He came down from his hermitage. Jurayj said, “Where is this woman who claims that her child is mine?” He said, “O baby, who is your father?” He said, “The shepherd.”

checkedBody: Narrated Abu Huraira:

Allah's Apostle said, "A woman called her son while he was in his hermitage and said, 'O Juraij' He said, 'O Allah, my mother (is calling me) and (I am offering) my prayer (what shall I do)?' She again said, 'O Juraij!' He said again, 'O Allah ! My mother (is calling me) and (I am offering) my prayer (what shall I do)?' She again said, 'O Juraij' He again said, 'O Allah! My mother (is calling me) and (I am offering) my prayer. (What shall I do?)' She said, 'O Allah! Do not let Juraij die till he sees the faces of prostitutes.' A shepherdess used to come by his hermitage for grazing her sheep and she gave birth to a child. She was asked whose child that was, and she replied that it was from Juraij and that he had come out from his hermitage. Juraij said, 'Where is that woman who claims that her child is from me?' (When she was brought to him along with the child), Juraij asked the child, 'O Babus, who is your father?' The child replied, 'The shepherd.' " (See Hadith No 662. Vol 3).

segments.arabic: [1152] حدثنا محمود حدثنا شبابة حدثنا شعبة عن محمد بن زياد عن أبي هريرة رضى الله تعالى عنه عن النبي ﷺ

segments.english: He performed a prayer and said: “Satan appeared to me and rushed at me to interrupt my prayer. Allah gave me power over him, and I choked him. I had intended to tie him to a pillar until morning came upon you and you could look at him. Then I remembered the words of Sulayman, peace be upon him: ‘My Lord, forgive me and grant me a kingdom that will not belong to anyone after me.’ So Allah sent him back humiliated.”

segments.arabic: ثم قال النضر بن شميل فذعته بالذال أي خنقته وفدعته من قول الله يوم يدعون أي يدفعون والصواب فدعته إلا أنه كذا قال بتشديد العين والتاء

Bestow on me a kingdom such as shall not belong to any other after me.' Then Allah made him (Satan) return with his head down (humiliated)."

segments.english: Adam related to us. Shu‘bah related to us. Al-Azraq ibn Qays related to us. He said:

segments.arabic: كنا بالأهواز نقاتل الحرورية فبينا أنا على جرف نهر إذا رجل يصلي وإذا لجام دابته بيده فجعلت الدابة تنازعه وجعل يتبعها
segments.english: We were at al-Ahwaz fighting the Haruriyyah. While I was on a riverbank, there was a man praying, with his animal’s bridle in his hand. The animal began to pull against him, and he began to follow it.

segments.arabic: قال شعبة هو أبو برزة الأسلمي

segments.arabic: فجعل رجل من الخوارج يقول اللهم افعل بهذا الشيخ فلما انصرف الشيخ قال
segments.english: A man of the Khawarij began saying, “O Allah, do something to this old man!” When the old man finished, he said:

segments.arabic: إني سمعت قولكم وإني غزوت مع رسول الله ﷺ ست غزوات أو سبع غزوات أو ثمان وشهدت تيسيره وإني إن كنت أن أراجع مع دابتي أحب إلي من أن أدعها ترجع إلى مألفها فيشق علي
segments.english: I heard what you said. I went on six expeditions or seven expeditions or eight with the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, and witnessed his making things easy. Indeed, to go back with my animal is dearer to me than letting it return to its accustomed place and thereby causing me hardship.

We were at Al-Ahwaz fighting the AlHaruriya (tribe). While I was at the bank of a river a man was praying and the reins of his animal were in his hands and the animal was struggling and he was following the animal. (Shu'ba, a sub-narrator, said that man was Abu Barza al-Aslaml). A man from the Khawarij said, "O Allah! Be harsh to this sheik." And when the sheik (Abu Barza) finished his prayer, he said, "I heard your remark. No doubt, I participated with Allah's Apostle in six or seven or eight holy battles and saw his leniency, and no doubt, I would rather retain my animal than let it return to its stable, as it would cause me much trouble. "

segments.english: Muhammad ibn Muqatil related to us. ‘Abdullah informed us. Yunus informed us, from al-Zuhri, from ‘Urwah. He said: ‘A’ishah said:

segments.english: The sun was eclipsed. The Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, stood and recited a long surah. Then he bowed and prolonged it. Then he raised his head, then began another surah. Then he bowed when he had completed it, and prostrated. Then he did that in the second. Then he said:

segments.arabic: إنهما آيتان من آيات الله فإذا رأيتم ذلك فصلوا حتى يفرج عنكم لقد رأيت في مقامي هذا كل شيء وعدته حتى لقد رأيت أريد أن آخذ قطفا من الجنة حين رأيتموني جعلت أتقدم ولقد رأيت جهنم يحطم بعضها بعضا حين رأيتموني تأخرت ورأيت فيها عمرو بن لحي وهو الذي سيب السوائب
segments.english: They are two signs among the signs of Allah. When you see that, pray until it is relieved for you. In this place where I stood, I saw everything I was promised. I even saw myself wanting to take a bunch from Paradise when you saw me beginning to move forward. And I saw Hell, its parts crushing one another, when you saw me move back. I saw in it ‘Amr ibn Luhayy, who was the one who set the sawa’ib loose.

checkedBody: Narrated 'Aisha:

Once the sun eclipsed and Allah's Apostle stood up for the prayer and recited a very long Sura and when bowed for a long while and then raised his head and started reciting another Sura. Then he bowed, and after finishing, he prostrated and did the same in the second Raka and then said, "These (lunar and solar eclipses) are two of the signs of Allah and if you see them, pray till the eclipse is over. No doubt, while standing at this place I saw everything promised to me by Allah and I saw (Paradise) and I wanted to pluck a bunch (of grapes) therefrom, at the time when you saw me stepping forward. No doubt, I saw Hell with its different parts destroying each other when you saw me retreating and in it I saw 'Amr bin Luhai who started the tradition of freeing animals (set them free) in the name of idols."

segments.arabic: [1159] حدثنا أبو معمر حدثنا عبد الوارث حدثنا كثير بن شنظير عن عطاء بن أبي رباح عن جابر بن عبد الله رضى الله تعالى عنهما قال

segments.english: The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, sent me on an errand for him. I went, then returned after completing it. I came to the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, and greeted him, but he did not reply to me. Something came into my heart which Allah knows best. I said to myself, “Perhaps the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, is angry with me because I was slow in returning to him.” Then I greeted him, but he did not reply to me, and something more intense than the first time came into my heart. Then I greeted him, and he replied to me. He said, “What prevented me from replying to you was that I was praying.” He was on his riding animal, facing a direction other than the qiblah.

segments.arabic: [1160] حدثنا قتيبة حدثنا عبد العزيز عن أبي حازم عن سهل بن سعد رضى الله تعالى عنه قال

segments.arabic: بلغ رسول الله ﷺ أن بني عمرو بن عوف بقباء كان بينهم شيء فخرج يصلح بينهم في أناس من أصحابه فحبس رسول الله ﷺ وحانت الصلاة فجاء بلال إلى أبي بكر رضى الله تعالى عنهما، فقال: يا أبا بكر إن رسول الله ﷺ قد حبس وقد حانت الصلاة فهل لك أن تؤم الناس قال: نعم إن شئت فأقام بلال الصلاة وتقدم أبو بكر رضى الله تعالى عنه فكبر للناس وجاء رسول الله ﷺ يمشي في الصفوف يشقها شقا حتى قام في الصف فأخذ الناس في التصفيح
segments.english: It reached the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, that something had happened among Banu ‘Amr ibn ‘Awf at Quba. He went out with some of his companions to reconcile them. The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, was delayed, and the time for prayer came. Bilal came to Abu Bakr, may Allah Most High be pleased with them both, and said, “O Abu Bakr, the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, has been delayed, and the time for prayer has come. Would you lead the people?” He said, “Yes, if you wish.” Bilal called the iqamah for prayer. Abu Bakr, may Allah Most High be pleased with him, went forward and pronounced the takbir for the people. The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, came walking through the rows, making his way through them, until he stood in the row. The people began clapping.

segments.arabic: قال سهل التصفيح هو التصفيق
segments.english: Sahl said: Tasfih is tasfiq—clapping.

segments.arabic: قال: وكان أبو بكر رضى الله تعالى عنه لا يلتفت في صلاته فلما أكثر الناس التفت فإذا رسول الله ﷺ فأشار إليه يأمره أن يصلي فرفع أبو بكر رضى الله تعالى عنه يده فحمد الله ثم رجع القهقري وراءه حتى قام في الصف وتقدم رسول الله ﷺ فصلى للناس فلما فرغ أقبل على الناس، فقال: يا أيها الناس ما لكم حين نابكم شيء في الصلاة أخذتم بالتصفيح إنما التصفيح للنساء من نابه شيء في صلاته فليقل سبحان الله
segments.english: He said: Abu Bakr, may Allah Most High be pleased with him, did not turn around during his prayer. When the people increased it, he turned, and there was the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace. He signalled to him, directing him to pray. Abu Bakr, may Allah Most High be pleased with him, raised his hand and praised Allah. Then he stepped backwards behind him until he stood in the row. The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, went forward and prayed for the people. When he finished, he turned towards the people and said, “O people, why, when something happened to you in prayer, did you begin clapping? Clapping is only for women. Whoever has something happen to him in his prayer should say, ‘Glory be to Allah.’”

segments.arabic: ثم التفت إلى أبي بكر رضى الله تعالى عنه، فقال: يا أبا بكر ما منعك أن تصلي للناس حين أشرت إليك قال أبو بكر ما كان ينبغي لابن أبي قحافة أن يصلي بين يدي رسول الله ﷺ
segments.english: Then he turned to Abu Bakr, may Allah Most High be pleased with him, and said, “O Abu Bakr, what prevented you from praying for the people when I signalled to you?” Abu Bakr said, “It was not fitting for the son of Abu Quhafah to pray in front of the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace.”

checkedBody: Narrated Sahl bin Sad:

The news about the differences amongst the people of Bani 'Amr bin 'Auf at Quba reached Allah's Apostle and so he went to them along with some of his companions to affect a reconciliation. Allah's Apostle was delayed there and the time for the prayer became due. Bilal came to Abu Bakr! and said, "O Abu Bakr! Allah's Apostle is detained (there) and the time for the prayer is due. Will you lead the people in prayer?" Abu Bakr replied, "Yes, if you wish." So Bilal pronounced the Iqama and Abu Bakr went forward and the people said Takbir. In the meantime, Allah's Apostle came piercing through the rows till he stood in the (first) row and the people started clapping. Abu Bakr, would never look hither and thither during the prayer but when the people clapped much he looked back and saw Allah's Apostle. The Prophet beckoned him to carry on. Abu Bakr raised both his hands, praised Allah and retreated till he stood in the row and Allah's Apostle went forward and led the people in the prayer. When he had finished the prayer, he addressed the people and said, "O people! Why did you start clapping when something happened to you in the prayer? Clapping is for women. Whenever one is confronted with something unusual in the prayer one should say, 'Sub Han Allah'." Then the Prophet looked towards Abu Bakr and asked, "What prevented you from leading the prayer when I beckoned you to carry on?" Abu Bakr replied, "It does not befit the son of Al Quhafa to lead the prayer in the presence of Allah's Apostle
